Description: Const widgets are cached and skip rebuild improving performance
Do: Add const to every widget constructor that can be const
Code Bad: Text('Hello World') // rebuilt every time parent rebuilds

Description: Build should only describe UI not perform logic
Do: Move logic to methods or state classes keep build declarative
Don't: Fetch data compute values or create controllers in build
Code Bad: @override Widget build(context) { final data = computeHeavyThing(); final controller = TextEditingController(); ... }

Description: Each widget should have a single responsibility
Do: Extract sub-widgets as separate classes not methods
Don't: One massive widget with 500+ line build method
Code Good: class UserAvatar extends StatelessWidget { }; class UserInfo extends StatelessWidget { }
Code Bad: class UserProfile extends StatefulWidget { // 500 lines in build }

Description: StatelessWidget is simpler and cannot hold mutable state
Do: Use StatelessWidget for widgets that only depend on constructor args
Don't: StatefulWidget for widgets that never call setState
Code Good: class PriceTag extends StatelessWidget { final double price; const PriceTag({required this.price}); }
Code Bad: class PriceTag extends StatefulWidget { // no state used }

Description: Material 3 provides modern adaptive color and shape system
Do: ThemeData.from with ColorScheme.fromSeed
Don't: Manual color definitions or Material 2 defaults
Code Bad: ThemeData( primarySwatch: Colors.blue, ) // Material 2

Description: Material 3 provides semantic color roles
Do: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary surface error etc
Code Bad: color: Colors.blue // doesn't adapt to theme

Description: Material You creates personalized colors from wallpaper
Do: DynamicColorBuilder for Android 12+ wallpaper-based themes
Code Bad: Ignoring dynamic color on Android // misses platform integration

Description: Material 3 defines specific button hierarchy
Do: FilledButton for primary OutlinedButton for secondary TextButton for tertiary
Code Good: FilledButton(onPressed: submit, child: Text('Save')); OutlinedButton(onPressed: cancel, child: Text('Cancel'))
Code Bad: ElevatedButton everywhere with manual color overrides

Description: Consistent corner radii from the shape theme
Do: Theme.of(context).shapes for small medium large extra-large
Code Bad: borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12) // hardcoded

Description: Row Column and Flex for linear layouts
Do: Row for horizontal Column for vertical Wrap for flow
Don't: Nested Rows in Rows or Columns in Columns unnecessarily
Code Bad: Column(children: [Column(children: [Text(title)])])  // unnecessary nesting

Guideline: Use Expanded and Flexible for proportions
Description: Distribute remaining space among children
Do: Expanded for equal distribution Flexible for min/max
Code Good: Row(children: [Expanded(flex: 2, child: content), Expanded(flex: 1, child: sidebar)])
Code Bad: Row(children: [SizedBox(width: 600, child: content), SizedBox(width: 300, child: sidebar)])

Description: SliverAppBar collapses and expands with scroll
Do: CustomScrollView with SliverAppBar for hero-style headers
Don't: AppBar with manual scroll listener for parallax
Code Bad: AppBar() + NotificationListener<ScrollNotification> for manual collapse

Description: LayoutBuilder provides parent constraints for adaptive UI
Do: LayoutBuilder to switch between mobile and tablet layouts
Code Good: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) { if (constraints.maxWidth > 600) return TabletLayout(); return MobileLayout(); })
Code Bad: final size = MediaQuery.of(context).size; // causes rebuilds on keyboard

Guideline: Use Padding not Container for spacing
Description: Container is heavyweight with many defaults
Do: Padding widget for simple spacing
Code Bad: Container(padding: EdgeInsets.all(16), child: Text('Hello')) // unnecessary Container

Description: go_router provides URL-based declarative navigation
Do: GoRouter with typed routes for web and mobile
Code Good: GoRouter(routes: [GoRoute(path: '/', builder: (_, __) => HomeScreen()), GoRoute(path: '/profile/:id', builder: (_, state) => ProfileScreen(id: state.pathParameters['id']!))])
Code Bad: Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => ProfileScreen())) // no deep linking

Guideline: Use shell routes for persistent UI
Description: ShellRoute wraps child routes with shared navigation UI
Do: ShellRoute for bottom nav bar and side drawer that persist
Don't: Rebuilding nav bar on every page
Code Good: ShellRoute(builder: (_, __, child) => Scaffold(body: child, bottomNavigationBar: AppBottomNav()), routes: [...])
Code Bad: Every screen: Scaffold(bottomNavigationBar: AppBottomNav(), body: ...)  // duplicated

Description: Type-safe route params prevent runtime errors
Do: GoRouterState.pathParameters with type conversion
Code Bad: final id = state.extra as int; // unsafe cast, breaks on deep link

Description: Riverpod provides compile-safe dependency injection and state
Do: Riverpod providers for shared state and dependency injection
Don't: setState for everything or Provider package
Code Bad: setState(() { _users = await api.getUsers(); }) // in StatefulWidget

Description: AsyncNotifierProvider for async mutable state with Riverpod
Do: AsyncNotifier for CRUD operations with loading/error states
Don't: FutureProvider that refetches on every read
Code Good: class TodoNotifier extends AsyncNotifier<List<Todo>> { Future<List<Todo>> build() => api.getTodos(); Future<void> add(Todo t) async { state = AsyncLoading(); state = AsyncData(await api.addTodo(t)); } }
Code Bad: final todosProvider = FutureProvider((ref) => api.getTodos()); // can't mutate

Guideline: Watch providers don't read in build
Description: ref.watch rebuilds widget on change ref.read doesn't
Do: ref.watch in build for reactive UI ref.read in callbacks
Don't: ref.read in build missing updates or ref.watch in callbacks
Code Good: final user = ref.watch(userProvider); // rebuilds when user changes
Code Bad: final user = ref.read(userProvider); // never updates OR ref.watch in onPressed

Description: select watches only specific fields preventing unnecessary rebuilds
Do: ref.watch(provider.select((s) => s.count)) for specific fields
Don't: Watching entire state when you need one field
Code Good: final name = ref.watch(userProvider.select((u) => u.name)); // only rebuilds on name change
Code Bad: final user = ref.watch(userProvider); // rebuilds on ANY user field change

Description: Centralize all theme configuration in one file
Do: Separate theme.dart with light and dark ThemeData
Code Good: class AppTheme { static ThemeData light = ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: brandColor, textTheme: _textTheme, useMaterial3: true); }
Code Bad: MaterialApp(theme: ThemeData(primaryColor: Colors.blue, textTheme: TextTheme(bodyLarge: TextStyle(...)))) // inline

Description: Material 3 TextTheme provides harmonious type scale
Do: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium bodyLarge etc
Code Bad: Text(title, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)) // manual

Description: Design both themes simultaneously
Do: ThemeData for both light and dark modes
Code Good: MaterialApp(theme: AppTheme.light, darkTheme: AppTheme.dark, themeMode: ThemeMode.system)
Code Bad: MaterialApp(theme: AppTheme.light) // no dark mode

Description: AnimatedContainer smoothly transitions between property values
Do: AnimatedContainer for size color padding changes
Code Good: AnimatedContainer(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300), width: isExpanded ? 200 : 100, curve: Curves.easeInOut)
Code Bad: TweenAnimationBuilder or AnimationController for a simple width change

Guideline: Use Hero for shared element transitions
Description: Hero widget creates smooth transition between routes
Do: Hero with matching tags on source and destination
Code Bad: Custom AnimationController calculating position between two screens

Description: Animate list items appearing in sequence
Do: AnimationController with Interval for staggered entrance
Code Good: ListView.builder(itemBuilder: (_, i) => SlideTransition(position: Tween(...).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: controller, curve: Interval(i * 0.1, 1))), child: item))
Code Bad: ListView.builder(itemBuilder: (_, i) => item) // no entrance animation

Description: Curves create physically realistic motion profiles
Do: Curves.easeOutCubic for deceleration Curves.spring for bounce
Code Bad: curve: Curves.linear // robotic feel

Description: Builder creates widgets lazily as they scroll into view
Do: ListView.builder for lists longer than 15-20 items
Don't: ListView with children list for dynamic data
Code Bad: ListView(children: items.map((i) => ItemTile(i)).toList()) // all built at once

Description: Separated builder adds dividers between items automatically
Do: ListView.separated with separatorBuilder for clean lists
Code Bad: ListView.builder(itemBuilder: (_, i) => Column(children: [ItemTile(items[i]), Divider()]))  // divider after last item too

Description: Keep expensive list items alive when scrolled off screen
Do: AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin for items with heavy state
Don't: Rebuilding complex items every time they scroll back
Code Good: class _ItemState extends State<Item> with AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin { @override bool get wantKeepAlive => true; }
Code Bad: Rebuilding video players or complex forms on every scroll

Description: Form widget manages validation state across fields
Do: Form with GlobalKey for validation and submission
Code Bad: TextField(controller: _ctrl) // no validation

Description: Consistent input styling across the app
Do: Theme-level InputDecorationTheme for global styling
Code Bad: TextFormField(decoration: InputDecoration(border: OutlineInputBorder(), filled: true)) // repeated

Guideline: Use Semantics widget for custom controls
Description: Semantics provides accessibility info for custom widgets
Do: Semantics label for custom-drawn or gesture-based controls
Code Good: Semantics(label: 'Play video', button: true, child: CustomPlayButton())
Code Bad: GestureDetector(onTap: play, child: CustomPlayButton()) // invisible to screen readers

Description: Respect user font size preferences
Do: MediaQuery.textScaleFactor and flexible text containers
Don't: Fixed-height containers that clip scaled text
Code Good: Text(title, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis) // gracefully handles large text
Code Bad: SizedBox(height: 20, child: Text(title)) // clips when text is scaled up

Description: Hide decorative images from screen readers
Do: ExcludeSemantics for decorative borders dividers and backgrounds
Don't: Decorative elements announced by screen readers
Code Bad: Image.asset('decorative-bg.png') // screen reader announces 'image'

Description: Isolate expensive painting operations from parent rebuilds
Do: RepaintBoundary around charts maps and complex custom paint
Don't: Entire screen repainting when one widget changes
Code Bad: CustomPaint(painter: ChartPainter(data)) // repaints with every parent build

Description: Const constructors prevent widget rebuilds
Do: const for all static widgets text and decorations
Don't: Rebuilding static widgets on every frame
Code Bad: SizedBox(height: 16); Text('Welcome'); // rebuilt unnecessarily

Description: Avoid re-downloading images on every build
Do: cached_network_image package for image caching
Code Bad: Image.network(url) // re-downloads frequently, no placeholder

Description: Use Flutter DevTools to find performance issues
Do: Performance overlay widget inspector and timeline
Code Bad: print('build called') // println debugging for performance
